title: Native Model Development and Training
purpose: Advance the provider-independent AI from inference and autonomous engineering into a governed local data/training/post-training/model-lifecycle system.

workstreams.name: Data, lineage and dataset foundation
workstreams.objective: Materialize content-addressed dataset ingestion, lineage, quality, registry and synthetic-data custody as the deterministic substrate for provider-independent model training.

workstreams.name: Model/data provenance and rights
workstreams.objective: Bind model bills of materials, license intelligence and data-usage rights into dataset and model promotion decisions.

workstreams.name: Native training control and recovery
workstreams.objective: Create a local training control plane with deterministic run identity, worker topology, checkpoint/resume, elastic fencing, observability and evaluation gates.

workstreams.name: Post-training, RL, curriculum and verifier models
workstreams.objective: Materialize bounded post-training experiments, deterministic RL environments, curriculum progression and independently calibrated verifier-model programs.

workstreams.name: Model lifecycle, deprecation and migration
workstreams.objective: Govern model promotion, deprecation, consumer migration and provider/local-model cutover with parity evidence and rollback-safe lifecycle state.

invariants: P3-T2 source scope equals the exact 197-volume queue left by merged P3-T1.
Scheduled and queued partitions are disjoint and together cover all 197 source volumes.
Every scheduled volume has exactly one task owner.
P3-T2 does not re-own P3-T0/P3-T1 volumes.
Training admission and model promotion fail closed when rights, lineage, checkpoint or evaluation evidence is missing.
File existence, line count or a passing happy path cannot promote masterplan maturity.
